newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Italy's Scalfaro arrives in Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Scalfaro arrives in Kazakhstan.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro arrived in resource-rich Kazakhstan on Sunday for a three-day official visit aimed at building ties between the two countries.

"Italy will help Kazakhstan's progress towards democracy and the construction of a free society," Scalfaro told reporters during a visit to the picturesque resort area of Medeu in the Tien Shan mountains near the Kazakh capital Almaty.
Scalfaro, who arrived in the former Soviet republic after visiting neighbouring Uzbekistan, will sign with Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev a friendship and cooperation treaty on Monday.
"Beyond doubt, the treaty will give a new impetus to the development of bilateral relations which have strong potential," the official Kazakhstanskaya Pravda daily said at the weekend.

The paper said that Italy is Kazakhstan's seventh largest trading partner and bilateral trade reached $239.3 million last year. It said there are now 46 joint ventures with Italian capital in Kazakhstan.
